PermissionSet.description: SMF-7: call the case-bound RealtimeKit token endpoint. Grants no record access: the endpoint still requires user-mode read access to the Case. No object permissions on the SMF7 room/participant objects (provider ids stay server-side). Assigned to MF-TECH, MF-SUPPORT and MF-RESTRICTED so denial comes from case access, not from a missing permission.
PermissionSet.label: SMF7 Call Access
